title: Greed Has Ruined a Formerly Relaxing Game — Do Not Add Swipe Limits!
content:
Wordscapes used to be my go-to game for a relaxing, brain-boosting break. Unfortunately, PeopleFun continues to push aggressive monetization tactics, and the introduction of the new Swipe Counter completely destroys what made this game special.
Restricting players to a set number of swipes per level fundamentally changes the core mechanics for the worse:
 Aggressive Cash Grab: If you run out of swipes, you are forced to burn hard-earned saved coins or pay real money just to buy extra moves to complete a puzzle.
 Punishes Bonus Word Exploration: Restricting turns means you no longer have the freedom to experiment and find extra bonus words to earn coins naturally.
 Unfair to Fast Players: Fast, experienced players who focus on the letter wheel instead of the board often experience mis-swipes or unrecognized words. Needing to re-swipe valid inputs now severely penalizes you under a strict move limit.
 Inaccessible & Exclusionary: This artificial barrier creates an unnecessary strain on non-native English speakers, newer players learning vocabulary, and players with cognitive disabilities or neurodivergence who need time and trial-and-error without pressure.
Adding a move counter turns a fun, accessible puzzle game into a stress-inducing pay-to-win system. If this feature is rolled out permanently across the game, I—along with many longtime players—will be uninstalling for good. Please listen to your community and remove the swipe limit!

author: Chris59293
title: Updates made game unplayable
content: I’ve spent many hours playing this game. It’s been my go-to game for passing the time for years. However, the recent updates have made this game completely unplayable for me. I get severe migraines from any flashing/ strobing lights. The last few updates have added flashes after completing a puzzle, distracting sparkles around the letters during the puzzle, and now the latest one added horrible flashes after every few words!! All of this is entirely unnecessary. There also is NOT an option to turn this off. The accessibility settings (which is a single slider for increasing contrast) are a JOKE! There is absolutely NO REASON to make these changes! I’ll check after the next few updates to see if those changes go away, otherwise I will have to delete the app sadly. Clearly NO ONE at this company cares about accessibility. Even if I didn’t get migraines, I’d be highly annoyed with all the flashing. It’s a word game not an f—ing slot machine.
